headline: Veeam software subscription up to $36,630.78 and federal aid to accept an additional $231,941.29 to rehabilitate Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges.
summary: The committee will consider a software subscription of up to $36,630.78. It will also consider a resolution on a second amended federal aid agreement for bridge rehabilitation.
items: Communication from Amy Girard, Purchasing Manager: subscription to the Veeam Data Platform Foundation Universal License, not to exceed $36,630.78, funded from General Fund/54-Property Services

Resolution R-26-075: authorize the Mayor to enter a second amended federal aid project agreement with the State of New Hampshire and the Town of Hudson to rehabilitate the Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges and accept an additional $231,941.29 for the project
